title: 在残疾世界中生活成本高昂(1)
desc: 在残疾世界中生活成本高昂(1)

paragraphs.en: At times, it feels as if the disability rights movement won.
paragraphs.zh: 有时，感觉残疾人权利运动似乎已经取得了胜利。

paragraphs.en: After years of groundwork, 1981 was declared the International Year of Disabled Persons.
paragraphs.zh: 经过多年的基础工作，1981年被宣布为国际残疾人年。

paragraphs.en: I was born that year, in Oslo, Norway, and though I did not receive my first diagnosis of muscular dystrophy until I was a toddler, the coincidence is apt enough: I was born into a world that was, at last, beginning to recognise this aspect of my being in it.
paragraphs.zh: 我于那年在挪威奥斯陆出生，尽管我直到蹒跚学步时才被首次诊断出患有肌肉萎缩症，但这一巧合恰如其分地表明：我出生在一个终于开始认可我身上这一特质的世界里。

paragraphs.en: Then, from 1983 to 1992, came the United Nations' Decade of Disabled Persons.
paragraphs.zh: 随后，从1983年到1992年，联合国设立了残疾人十年。

paragraphs.en: And the Americans With Disabilities Act, the UK's Disability Discrimination Act and the UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，还有《美国残疾人法案》、英国《残疾人歧视法》以及《联合国残疾人权利公约》。

paragraphs.en: The turn of the millennium was marked by a litany of good intentions and disavowals of unequal treatment – by an endorsement, as the first article of the UN convention has it, of disabled people's right to "full and effective participation in society on an equal basis with others".
paragraphs.zh: 千禧年之交，一系列善意之举和对不平等待遇的否定成为时代标志——正如联合国公约第一条所述，这是对残疾人“与他人平等充分和有效地参与社会”权利的认可。

paragraphs.en: I came of age in this world, more or less protected by these rights.
paragraphs.zh: 我在这个世界长大成人，或多或少受到这些权利的保护。

paragraphs.en: In Norway, which produced its own act in 2008, I received an education, found work and started a family.
paragraphs.zh: 在挪威，这个于2008年颁布了本国法案的国家，我接受了教育，找到了工作，并组建了家庭。

paragraphs.en: I am writing this as a tenured professor, as well-protected as a member of a protected class can be.
paragraphs.zh: 我写下这些文字时，是一位拥有终身教职的教授，作为受保护阶层的一员，我得到了充分的保障。

paragraphs.en: And yet I am writing with a feeling, as Tony Soprano had it, that I came in at the end – that the best, in the sense of our best and greatest hopes for universal, rights-based protections, and for the logic of anti-discrimination, is over.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，我写作时却带着一种感觉，正如托尼·索普拉诺所言，我赶上了末班车——从我们对基于权利的普遍保护以及反歧视逻辑抱有的最美好、最伟大的期望这个意义上来说，最好的时代已经过去了。

paragraphs.en: Some protections have been eroded, usually in the name of budgetary constraints.
paragraphs.zh: 一些保护措施已被削弱，通常是以预算限制为名。

paragraphs.en: I also suspect that the big conversation – about whether disabled people should have "equal rights" – has sometimes served to obscure the innumerable material inequalities that make up lived experience.
paragraphs.zh: 我还怀疑，那场关于残疾人是否应该拥有“平等权利”的重大讨论，有时反而掩盖了构成现实生活体验的无数实际不平等现象。

paragraphs.en: And perhaps we need to have a different conversation in order to understand this world: the conversation about work.
paragraphs.zh: 或许我们需要进行一场不同的讨论，以理解这个世界：那就是关于工作的讨论。

paragraphs.en: The playground outside my son's kindergarten is enclosed by a wooden fence that is about 1.5 metres high.
paragraphs.zh: 我儿子幼儿园外的操场被一道约1.5米高的木栅栏围住。

paragraphs.en: The gate, also wooden, is opened with a sliding bolt placed at the very top – high enough to stop any enterprising toddler from escaping into the adjacent car park.
paragraphs.zh: 大门也是木制的，由一个安装在最顶端的插销开启——这个高度足以防止任何调皮的幼儿逃到旁边的停车场去。

paragraphs.en: In order to open the gate, I have to raise the seat of my wheelchair as high as it goes, a full foot or so from its lowest setting.
paragraphs.zh: 为了打开大门，我必须将轮椅的座位升至最高，比最低设置高出整整一英尺左右。

paragraphs.en: This allows me to stand up and reach the bolt.
paragraphs.zh: 这样我才能站起来够到门闩。

paragraphs.en: If it rains or snows, as it often does in Oslo, the wood expands and the bolt becomes hard to shift.
paragraphs.zh: 如果遇到雨雪天气——这在奥斯陆很常见——木头会膨胀，门闩就变得难以移动。

paragraphs.en: I have to watch my balance, especially as I take a few steps out from my wheelchair in order to close the gate behind me; there is no way to do this while I'm seated.
paragraphs.zh: 我必须注意保持平衡，尤其是在离开轮椅走几步去关身后的大门时；然而坐在轮椅上的我无法完成这个动作。

paragraphs.en: For my son and me, this task has become a game and a joint effort.
paragraphs.zh: 对于我和儿子来说，这项任务已经变成了一种游戏和共同的努力。

paragraphs.en: He helps push the gate open.
paragraphs.zh: 他帮忙推开大门。

paragraphs.en: Standing on tiptoe on the footrest of the wheelchair, he can reach the bolt himself, just about.
paragraphs.zh: 他踮着脚尖站在轮椅的脚踏板上，自己刚好能够到门闩。

paragraphs.en: He knows what we're doing, and his part in it.
paragraphs.zh: 他知道我们在做什么，以及他在其中的角色。

paragraphs.en: It was tougher when he was three, and I didn't want to shift my attention from him for even a second, with cars and trucks liable to enter the car park at any time.
paragraphs.zh: 在他三岁时情况更艰难，因为汽车和卡车随时可能驶入停车场，我一秒钟都不想把注意力从他身上移开。

paragraphs.en: The gate is old. I wouldn't mind seeing it replaced. But I'm hesitant to make a request.
paragraphs.zh: 这扇门很旧了。我倒不介意看到它被换掉。但我不太想提出更换的请求。

paragraphs.en: I've seen the new gates appearing at other kindergartens throughout the city, outfitted with a bolt that does not slide but has to be pushed up.
paragraphs.zh: 我看到全市其他幼儿园都装上了新门，新门配备的插销不能滑动，得往上推。

paragraphs.en: My triceps and shoulder muscles are significantly weaker than my biceps.
paragraphs.zh: 我的三头肌和肩部肌肉比二头肌弱很多。

paragraphs.en: I have no way of opening these new gates on my own.
paragraphs.zh: 我自己根本打不开这些新门。

paragraphs.en: And I want to take my son to kindergarten myself, for this very short, very long stretch of his life.
paragraphs.zh: 而我想亲自送儿子去幼儿园，在他人生这段既短暂又漫长的时光里。

paragraphs.en: There are, of course, other parents.
paragraphs.zh: 当然，还有其他家长。

paragraphs.en: During rush hour in the morning and early afternoon, barely a few minutes pass without someone dropping off or picking up.
paragraphs.zh: 在早上和午后的高峰时段，几乎每隔几分钟就有人送孩子来或者接孩子走。

paragraphs.en: This has given me, over the years, a range of social experiences at the entrance to the kindergarten.
paragraphs.zh: 这些年来，这让我在幼儿园门口有了各种各样的社交体验。

paragraphs.en: Some parents rushed to help open the gate from the first.
paragraphs.zh: 有些家长从一开始就赶忙帮忙开门。

paragraphs.en: Some seemed hesitant, but needed only a bit of encouragement – a nod, a smile, a "Would you mind … " – and that would be enough.
paragraphs.zh: 有些家长似乎有些犹豫，但只需要一点鼓励——一个点头、一个微笑、一句“你介意……吗”——就足够了。

paragraphs.en: In some encounters, though, there was only a kind of void.
paragraphs.zh: 不过，在某些交流中，却只有一种空洞感。

paragraphs.en: In these encounters, I knew with perfect clarity that if I wanted this person's help, I'd have to ask for it, loud and clear.
paragraphs.zh: 在这些交流中，我非常清楚地知道，如果我想得到这个人的帮助，我就得大声明确地提出请求。

paragraphs.en: Direct gaze, firm voice. "Can you please open the gate for me?"
paragraphs.zh: 直视对方，声音坚定。“你能帮我打开这扇门吗？”

paragraphs.en: I don't always have the surplus energy for this.
paragraphs.zh: 我并非总有多余的精力来做这件事。

paragraphs.en: I know that the physical effort I will expend in opening the gate is an order of magnitude larger than what I'm asking of this other person, who can slide the bolt effortlessly, push and pull the gate with barely a thought.
paragraphs.zh: 我知道，我打开那扇门所耗费的体力，要比我请求别人帮忙时对方所付出的体力大得多，别人可以毫不费力地滑动门闩，几乎不用思考就能推拉那扇门。

paragraphs.en: But I also know that the physical effort I'll be expending can be less strenuous than the emotional effort of saying the right words in precisely the right way.
paragraphs.zh: 但我也知道，我付出的体力，可能比用恰到好处的方式说出恰当话语所付出的情感精力要轻松一些。

paragraphs.en: The other parents are, as a group and as individuals, helpful and kind.
paragraphs.zh: 其他家长无论是作为一个群体还是个体，都乐于助人且心地善良。

paragraphs.en: They are social democrats and egalitarians. They believe in equality.
paragraphs.zh: 他们是社会民主主义者和平等主义者。他们信奉平等。

paragraphs.en: At one time, my wife was talking to one of the other mothers in the kindergarten; they were talking about their lives.
paragraphs.zh: 有一次，我妻子在幼儿园和另一位母亲聊天，她们在谈论自己的生活。

paragraphs.en: I came up, my wheelchair came up, and the woman, hesitantly, said that she hadn't wanted to impose, by helping with the gate.
paragraphs.zh: 我坐着轮椅过来了，那位女士犹豫地说，她之前不想因为帮我开门而给我造成负担。

paragraphs.en: She'd seen me, naturally, but she had a notion that it was important to see me as a person, not just the wheelchair.
paragraphs.zh: 她自然是看到我了，但她觉得把我当作一个人来看待很重要，而不只是看到我的轮椅。

paragraphs.en: And so she had made a decision not to offer help.
paragraphs.zh: 所以她决定不主动提供帮助。
